PARAM:tau_ij.meaning: penetration probability of missile i against target j in adversarial environment

PARAM:xi.meaning: random variable sampled in adversarial penetration simulation

VAR:x_ij.meaning: 1 if missile i is allocated to target j; 0 otherwise

DERIVED:p_ij.meaning: kill probability of missile i against target j in the paper's simplified model

DERIVED:K_j(X).meaning: set of missiles assigned to target j

DERIVED:p_j(X).meaning: joint kill probability of missiles assigned to target j without adversarial interception

DERIVED:tau_j(X).meaning: joint penetration value for missiles assigned to target j

DERIVED:K'_j.meaning: surviving missile set after stochastic interception

OBJ:E.meaning: baseline MTA combat effectiveness without adversarial interception

OBJ:E_adv.meaning: AMTA expected combat effectiveness after stochastic missile penetration

OBJ:C.meaning: optional combat-cost objective for multiobjective AMTA extension

CON:C1.meaning: each missile is allocated to exactly one target

SEMANTIC:unsupported_robust_max_min_scen.meaning: robust max-min scenario objective unless explicitly requested by a sample

SEMANTIC:unsupported_target_lower_upper_.meaning: target lower/upper assignment bounds not present in the paper's basic AMTA model

SEMANTIC:unsupported_missile_type_invent.meaning: missile type inventory constraints not part of the basic AMTA formulation

SEMANTIC:unsupported_time_windows__dynam.meaning: time windows, dynamic replanning or stage survival recurrence

SEMANTIC:unsupported_dqn_state__action_a.meaning: DQN state, action and reward variables as optimization decision variables

SEMANTIC:unsupported_planted_assignment_.meaning: planted assignment or sampled penetration outcomes in public input

algorithm_boundary: PODRL, DQN state-action design, fair sample and reward shaping are learning/solution machinery, not the mathematical MTA/AMTA formulation
